listing.name: Rumble Racing — RumbleRacingPC (Ehren1337)
listing.summary: This unfinished source project reaches menus, track and car selection, races, laps and results. Busy scenes, rendering and audio have remaining issues. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own extracted USA SLUS20174 disc with GLBLDATA.PS2, DATA/ and MODULES/. Check the ELF and AUDIO.IRX hashes against port-lock.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract, generate code and build locally using the project’s source instructions. This is not a finished downloadable game.

warnings: This unfinished source project reaches menus, track and car selection, races, laps and results. Busy scenes, rendering and audio have remaining issues.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
